_comment: Repos whose suite is ALREADY red for reasons unrelated to this package.
EMPTY as of 2026-08-13. Every entry that was here has been fixed rather than exempted:
xen-vps             P-1, a use-before-assign that made deactivation fatal
plesk-webhosting    P-2, wrong constructor arity AND the wrong server's credentials
cloudlinux-licensing  D-2 undispatched hooks removed, D-3 xml_rpc2 taken from our fork
webhosting-module   two API functions published that had never been registered
mail-module         PRORATE_BILLING primed so its own Plugin class can load
virtuozzo-vps       the harness App stand-in installed so the suite runs standalone
ips-vps-addon       a test that asserted on its checkout directory, not its package
The weekly job fails on ANY repo that is red. Adding an entry here needs a reason a
reviewer can check, and it should be rare -- an exemption is a decision to ship a known
defect, not a way to quiet a build.
A repo listed here that goes GREEN is also reported, because a stale entry silently
exempts a real regression. That report is what caught six of the seven above.
P-bugs and owner decisions are tracked in docs/plugin-harness-findings.md in MyAdmin core.
